description.translate: Six azaleas will restore the small garden around the reading walk. Let something living share the space we are repairing. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

The Snow Queen's shielding became the ring's protective ward. The Hydra's captured vitality remained sealed for its greater awakening. With the memorial bond, that vitality can answer a fatal blow as Guardian's Last Stand. The dragon's flight awakens with it. Each gift remains bound to its rightful bearer.
